Name: Adopting Jas
Author: Sunnyoid
Description:
[heading]Description:[/heading]
This mod gives you the opportunity to adopt Jas and welcome her into your family while still keeping her connections to Marnie, Shane, and the rest of Pelican Town. I love Jas and wanted to adopt her, and know that some people who are married to Shane wanted to adopt her as well! 

You can be married to any spouse to use this mod, and there is a different storyline specifically for those who are married to Shane and want to adopt Jas.

This is my first Stardew Valley mod so please be gentle lol. Please reach out to me if there are any issues, since this is my first mod, you are welcome to try your hand at fixing certain things/adding more material yourself! 

[heading]Installation instructions:[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/?utm_source=chatgpt.com]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?utm_source=chatgpt.com]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip the folder.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]Adopting Jas[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI![/*]
[/list][heading]How to Adopt Jas:[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install all required mods, including SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Have More Kids.[/*]
[*]Start a new day while married to a spouse or roommate. (The Shane co-parent patch provides an alternate storyline for players married to Shane.)[/*]
[*]Wait for Marnie's invitation to arrive in your mailbox.[/*]
[*]Read the letter and follow the instructions to trigger the adoption event.[/*]
[*]After viewing the event, wait 7 in-game days for Jas to become available through the Have More Kids adoption registry.[/*]
[*]Visit the adoption registry (on the clinic desk) and complete the adoption process for Jas.[/*]
[/list]Once the adoption is complete, the Have More Kids Mod will handle bringing Jas into your farmhouse as your child.

[i]Please note: Watching the event does not automatically adopt Jas. You must complete the adoption through Have More Kids![/i]
[heading]
Main features:
[/heading]
- Some new dialogue for Jas after adoption.
- New dialogue for Marnie and Shane that reflects their ongoing relationship with Jas.
- Jas gets to keep her relationships with the people she already loves.
- Compatible with different spouses and roommates.
- Optional Shane-specific patch for players who are married to Shane and want him to have a more involved role in the adoption story.
[heading]
Requirements:[/heading]
Required:
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/?utm_source=chatgpt.com]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?utm_source=chatgpt.com]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436?utm_source=chatgpt.com][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36459?utm_source=chatgpt.com]Have More Kids[/url] mod (for the adoption registry integration)[/*]
[*]Adopting Jas - Shane Co-Parent Patch (optional alternate storyline for players married to Shane)[/*]
[/list][heading]
